name: mixsight
description: MixSight monorepo root. See SCOPE.md for product spec, CLAUDE.md for operating manual.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml down -v && pnpm db:up
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn mixsight.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.typecheck:api: cd apps/api && uv run mypy src
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check src
scripts.format:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff format src
scripts.migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.migrate:down: cd apps/api && uv run alembic downgrade -1
scripts.migrate:history: cd apps/api && uv run alembic history
